open_items: HQ not stated: the portfolio page lists a Menlo Park, CA office and a Bengaluru office without naming a headquarters. hq_city and hq_country left out.

Rhoda AI: the fetched Robotics 24/7 page lists Premji Invest among investors but I could not read a sentence naming it lead (Business Wire returned 403); other outlets in search results say Premji led at about $1.7B valuation. Recorded as participant.

Premji's firm website gave no thesis text, check size, fund size, application route or cold-inbound policy. The ~$10B figure is from one press article. Founder lead 'Physical AI; Infrastructure' from the user list is consistent with Rhoda and Upscale but not stated by the firm.
Upscale AI amount/stage come from Venture Intelligence; DealStreetAsia showed only a headline ($2B valuation, Premji leads).
Emversity website, founding year and sector (education) have no matching sector id.
